_comment_franchises: Auto-discovery. Anything a listed company has coming is picked up without you adding it. company_id is resolved from the name on first run and cached in cache/companies.json -- set it here to pin one.
_comment_watchlist: Hand-edited. type is movie or tv. Leave id null and run `python resolve.py` to fill it in from the title -- then eyeball it, because a title search can pick the wrong show.

watchlist.title: Peacemaker
watchlist.label: DC
watchlist._note: TMDB marks it Ended though season 3 is announced, so studio discovery drops it. Pinned here so it cannot fall out of scope.

_comment_ignore: tmdb ids that auto-discovery keeps surfacing and you do not care about.
_comment_window: How long something already released stays on the list, so a release is not missed by looking a day late.
_comment_animation: Animated series and films are dropped from studio discovery (TMDB genre 16). Flip to false to let DC/Marvel animation back in.
